title: REQ · Shared max-length constant drives a visible n / max counter
summary: A MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH constant is exported and the sheet shows a live 'n / max' counter
description: Context: client.ts exports MAX_PER_PLAYER but no length constant. Desired behavior: export MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH = 500 and render a counter beside the textarea that updates on every change. Expected result: the player always sees how much room is left. Why: the limit must be visible before it is exceeded.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open with empty text, Then the counter reads '0 / 500'
Given the text 'hello', Then the counter reads '5 / 500'
Given the text '  hi  ', Then the counter reads '2 / 500' because it counts trimmed characters
Given the textarea, Then it is described by the counter via aria-describedby

preserve: Existing aria-describedby for the blank message

technical_constraints: Constant lives next to MAX_PER_PLAYER in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts
definition_of_done: Counter renders and updates; constant exported
